summary: Woman bitten on the right forearm through her tent ~5:30 a.m. at Park Creek Campground (Rio Grande National Forest) near South Fork; puncture treated by EMS on scene with follow-up treatment at Rio Grande Hospital; offending bear not captured; campground closed for the season.
location: Park Creek Campground, Rio Grande National Forest, near South Fork
notes: CPW 9/14/2026 release; CPW's 10th confirmed bear attack of 2026 (most on record; attack = bodily injury by a bear).
